unit_cn: Unit 2 Wildlife Protection 野生动物保护
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 2 词表(p13 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、野生动物保护主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。专有名词(Tibetan/Yangtze 等)略去。

words.example_en: We must work together for wildlife protection.
words.example_cn: 我们必须共同努力保护野生动物。

words.example_en: The government placed the antelope under national protection.
words.example_cn: 政府把羚羊置于国家保护之下。

words.example_en: Hunting and pollution endanger many wild species.
words.example_cn: 捕猎和污染危害许多野生物种。

words.example_en: The panda is no longer an endangered species today.
words.example_cn: 如今熊猫不再是濒危物种了。

words.example_en: Between 150 and 200 species become extinct every day.
words.example_cn: 每天有150到200个物种灭绝。

words.example_en: Many animals have already become extinct because of hunting.
words.example_cn: 许多动物已因捕猎而灭绝。

words.example_en: We must save this species from extinction.
words.example_cn: 我们必须使这一物种免于灭绝。

words.example_en: Their habitat is getting smaller as new roads are built.
words.example_cn: 随着新路修建,它们的栖息地越来越小。

words.meaning_cn: (动植物)保护区;储备;预订;保留
words.example_en: The nature reserve is a shelter for wild animals and plants.
words.example_cn: 这个自然保护区是野生动植物的庇护所。

words.example_en: We came here to observe the antelope on the plain.
words.example_cn: 我们来这里观察平原上的羚羊。

words.example_en: We can just make out a herd of graceful animals.
words.example_cn: 我们勉强能看清一群优雅的动物。

words.example_en: Scientists watched over the antelopes to observe their habits.
words.example_cn: 科学家们看护着羚羊以观察它们的习性。

words.example_en: Hunters used to hunt antelopes for their valuable fur.
words.example_cn: 猎人过去为珍贵的毛皮捕猎羚羊。

words.example_en: Illegal hunters shot the animals to make profits.
words.example_cn: 非法猎人射杀这些动物以牟利。

words.example_en: The illegal trade in animal fur must be stopped.
words.example_cn: 动物毛皮的非法交易必须被制止。

words.example_en: The antelopes were hunted illegally for their fur.
words.example_cn: 羚羊为其毛皮被非法捕猎。

words.example_en: Please do not buy goods made from animal fur.
words.example_cn: 请不要购买用动物毛皮制成的商品。

words.example_en: Hunters were shooting antelopes to make money.
words.example_cn: 猎人们为了赚钱射杀羚羊。

words.example_en: Some people kill wild animals only to make profits.
words.example_cn: 有些人杀害野生动物只为牟利。

words.example_en: These animals face a serious threat from hunters.
words.example_cn: 这些动物面临来自猎人的严重威胁。

words.example_en: Human activities are threatening animals and plants.
words.example_cn: 人类活动正威胁着动植物。

words.example_en: Volunteers watched over the antelopes to keep them safe from attacks.
words.example_cn: 志愿者看护羚羊,使它们免遭袭击。

words.example_en: What measures are being taken to help the elephants?
words.example_cn: 正在采取什么措施来帮助大象?

words.example_en: The measures proved to be very effective.
words.example_cn: 这些措施被证明非常有效。

words.example_en: The antelope population has recovered in recent years.
words.example_cn: 近年来羚羊数量已经恢复。

words.example_en: The antelope was removed from the endangered species list.
words.example_cn: 羚羊已从濒危物种名单中移除。

words.example_en: The government does not intend to stop the protection.
words.example_cn: 政府不打算停止这项保护。

words.example_en: We must learn to exist in harmony with nature.
words.example_cn: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共存。

words.example_en: Humans and animals should live in harmony.
words.example_cn: 人类和动物应当和谐相处。

words.example_en: We should reduce the threat to wildlife.
words.example_cn: 我们应当减少对野生动物的威胁。

words.example_en: Wildlife is dying out at an alarming rate.
words.example_cn: 野生动物正以惊人的速度消失。

words.example_en: The report gives some alarming facts about extinction.
words.example_cn: 这份报告给出了一些关于灭绝的惊人事实。

words.example_en: We must make people aware of the problem.
words.example_cn: 我们必须让人们意识到这个问题。

words.example_en: I'm concerned about the African elephants.
words.example_cn: 我很担心非洲象。

words.example_en: Many people are concerned about wildlife protection.
words.example_cn: 许多人关心野生动物保护。

words.example_en: The authorities are under pressure to build animal parks.
words.example_cn: 当局承受着修建动物园区的压力。

words.example_en: The authorities tell people not to buy elephant products.
words.example_cn: 当局告诉人们不要购买大象制品。

words.example_en: It is difficult for elephants to adapt to the changes.
words.example_cn: 大象很难适应这些变化。

words.example_en: The world must protect these beautiful creatures.
words.example_cn: 世界必须保护这些美丽的生物。

words.example_en: Many elephants are killed on average every day.
words.example_cn: 平均每天有许多大象被杀害。

words.example_en: To Zhaxi, the land is sacred and worth protecting.
words.example_cn: 对扎西来说,这片土地是神圣的、值得保护的。

words.example_en: The antelopes remind me of the danger they were in.
words.example_cn: 这些羚羊使我想起它们曾面临的危险。

words.example_en: We made a poster to call for wildlife protection.
words.example_cn: 我们制作了一张海报呼吁保护野生动物。

words.example_en: A good poster can stir up strong emotions in people.
words.example_cn: 一张好的海报能激起人们强烈的情感。

words.example_en: Write a title that is simple and unusual.
words.example_cn: 写一个简洁而不寻常的标题。

words.example_en: Living spaces for wildlife are reduced due to the cutting of trees.
words.example_cn: 由于砍伐树木,野生动物的生存空间在减少。
